visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: ALC blue header, light grey striped rows
visualCharacteristics.structure: header row + data rows, horizontal scroll on small screens

contentPattern: First row = header cells (one per column), following rows = data cells. Cells can hold text, links, bold text. A single-row block renders as data only. Option no-header renders every row as data.
reuseGuidance: Use for tabular data such as top prizes remaining, odds, or schedules. Not for layout.
